notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - V.0.0.0.5
notes.content:
Rejoice, Gladiators!

[b]Patch 0.0.0.5 is live[/b], updating the Demo with some bug fixes, balance changes and new loot tables!

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

→ Mutilate chance will now properly detach those pesky limbs.

→ Armless Gladiators, fear not, you may now resort to headbutting your enemies!

→ Endurance, dexterity and strength are now properly displaying their stat modifiers in the Profile page.

→ Fixed a bug that could break the Mercator's shop upon refreshing it.

→ Fixed a bug that was incorrectly displaying the stats on an item if it was being compared with an another that was stored in the stash.

→ Severed limbs can no longer be used to mutilate enemies. You'll be needing a blade for that!

→ Equipment is properly unequipped from enemies upon their deaths (if the drop chance gods allow it).

→ Stash slots, Mercator slots and fight slots no longer reset when your Gladiator perishes, allowing you to keep that progression

→ Loot rarity has been temporarily buffed so you can experiment with cooler, better items way earlier in the demo
